name: Akan
note: Parent macrolanguage. The concept layer is shared across all Akan varieties; surface layers (lexicon, phonemes, grammar, wordforms) are dialect-tagged.

name: Asante Twi
note: Most widely spoken Akan variety; the product's default spoken target. Audio: Khaya/GhanaNLP + radio.

name: Akuapem Twi
note: Classical literary standard. Christaller's base dialect (Grammar §4 'the Literary Dialect, based on the Dialect of Akuapem').

name: Fante
note: Coastal, more divergent. ts/dz for t/d before front vowels (Christaller §14).

name: Shared / pan-Akan
note: Forms not specific to one dialect (or standardized pan-Akan sources). Included in every dialect view.

name: Somali
note: Abdi's language; next-language expansion for the demo. Standardized Latin orthography since 1972; abundant broadcast audio (BBC Somali, VOA Somali). No records yet.
